The part a foreign vendor cannot match

Your data stays in the country

Maintenance records describe how your plant runs. They are held in Morocco.

Invoiced in dirhams

No conversion, no dollar price that moves with the exchange rate, no foreign payment to set up.

Support that can reach the site

Questions answered in French or English, in your working hours, by people who can come to the plant.

Aligned with Made in Morocco

The national industrial programme pushes local capability and digital autonomy. A Moroccan CMMS on a Moroccan site counts toward that.
